title: Hevy Strength Session Volume Load Leaderboard
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hevy:workout volume_kg=*
| stats sum(volume_kg) as total_value, avg(volume_kg) as avg_value by muscle_group
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks muscle group values by total and average volume load across Hevy workout events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `volume_kg` values for each Hevy workout event and review total and average volume load by muscle group.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total volume load.
grandmaExplanation: It calmly which muscle group shows the biggest volume load numbers in your Hevy workout data.
